decisions.decision: Accepted the one changed test expectation: location()'s fallback assertion moves from time.Local to clock.Zone().
decisions.why: The fallback genuinely changed under D4, so the old assertion would now be false against intended behavior. The test still asserts something equally strong — not weakened, not deleted. Leader read the diff to confirm.

decisions.decision: Swapped the nil-Config.Location fallback even though that branch is unreachable in production.
decisions.why: cmd/poller always sets Location or exits fatally, so only the offline test hits it. Migrating it while inert is safer than leaving a stale time.Local for tier 7's tz-guard to trip over later.

decisions.decision: Correcting the record: the wave-complete and T7 notes claimed 'openspec validate --strict passes' before that command had actually been read. It was FAILING at the time.
decisions.why: The spec delta's SHALL sat on the second wrapped line and the validator only reads the first. Reworded so SHALL leads; it now genuinely passes. The false claim is left visible here rather than quietly edited away.
